# Embedded emissions cannot be calculated: the CN code is missing

The ruleset requires three inputs:

| Required input | Provided? |
|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | **No.** "A steel product" is not a CN code. |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | Yes: China |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | Yes: 500 t |

Default SEE values depend on both the CN code and the country. "A steel product" could match several China entries with different values, so I can't pick one without estimating, which the ruleset forbids.

## What the result would be, depending on the CN code

These are reference figures only. They are not the answer.

| CN code | Good | China SEE (tCO2e/t) | × 500 t = Embedded emissions |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen (an iron product, likely not "steel") | 1.66 | 830.00 tCO2e |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, iron/non-alloy steel | 1.74 | 870.00 tCO2e |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products, iron/non-alloy steel | 3.314 | 1,657.00 tCO2e |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, with indentations | 3.169 | 1,584.50 tCO2e |

The steel candidates alone range from 870.00 to 1,657.00 tCO2e, so the choice of code matters a lot.

## Next step

Please give the CN code of the steel product, for example from the customs declaration or commercial invoice. I'll then calculate the exact embedded emissions. If the product's CN code is not in the table, it can't be calculated under this ruleset.
